cc:Work.dc:title: Grey Noise (Vision)
cc:Work.dc:description: Grey, by vision. An optical analogue, not standard audio grey noise. The true color is outside sRGB. 380–700 nm; curve normalized to its peak. CIE 1931 2 degree observer; direct sRGB/D65 conversion; peak linear RGB=1. Background #7C00FF; clipped channels: G.

cc:Agent.dc:title: CIE (2019), doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b. CIE data and derived figure: CC BY-SA 4.0.
